historical_tail_test.caveat: Source-reported backtest; not a calibrated probability forecast and may be affected by overlapping/serially dependent observations and model construction.

options.source_method: Deribit public API; daily 00:01 UTC anchor; XRP USDC-settled options, 1 contract = 1,000 XRP.
limitations: XRP options have fewer expiries/strikes than BTC/ETH; skew/ranges can move more.
Options flow can represent hedges, spreads or dealer inventory.
Historical 3-sigma exceedance rate is source-reported and requires independent reproduction before model use.
options.source_disagreement: OptimistFi's Nov 10 22:00 snapshot reports 30-day ATM IV 58.6% and +1.1-point 25-delta skew with calls richer; Fuelmaps' Nov 11 00:01 snapshot reports tenor-specific IVs and defines positive 25-delta skew as puts richer. Different capture times, tenors and opposite sign conventions; no reconciliation without raw option chain and formula.
